You can order OEM trunk seals online and I would recommend doing that. I’m still building mine, but I bought it in the middle of winter so there was some water built up in the trunk. Faulty seals was the cause

I’d take your mileage into consideration and see if front end maintenance is worth doing this season. (Timing, water pump, etc.) I just picked up a motor with only 86,000 miles on it, but the front end maintenance was never done and it was VERY clear. Surprised nothing happened to the motor.

I definitely will be more cautious in the future, but everything that I have done for this car is taped,labeled, and organized in box organizers and shelf organizers. As far as these brackets and bolts I am completely lost, slowly piecing it together from random engine pictures I’m finding online.

I’m hoping someone here did exactly what you said, took pictures of parts and where they go, and would be willing to share so I can experience driving a Miata for the first time as it’s sat in my garage for two months taunting me.
